1. The whole site, top to bottom, as a visitor scrolls through it.

  1. Change the site’s photos from a phone or a computer.

    Every photo on the page can be swapped, moved or captioned, including new ones added from a phone right at the job site. Nothing changes for visitors until Publish is pressed.

  2. A private sign-in behind a password, kept off the public site.

  3. A live preview of the real site on a phone. Tap any photo in it to change it.

    The recent-work gallery. Press and hold a photo to move it; the first four sit on the page.

    The same live preview, as the site looks on a computer.

  4. On a computer it’s all on one screen: every photo down the side, the live preview in the middle, and the details for the photo being changed.
